title: State inspection blocked for five months, then hasty return home
place_text: Baker Victory Services / Springville, New York

tellings.quote: apparently for 5 months, the record something goes, uh, Baker Victory Services was refusing access to the state to come in and inspect me,

plain: In 2010, according to Jordan Jose, Baker Victory Services in Springville, New York, where he was staying as a child, refused for five months to let the state come in and inspect him, and then he was quickly sent back home. Jose tells this on the show as his own story. He says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a boy, and he cites the record of the case: "for 5 months, the record something goes," the organization "was refusing access to the state." If true, it would suggest someone wanted to keep officials away from him.
